parse_dme_training_args: parse command line arguments for the DME model training experiment configuration
get_available_embeddings: get a list of available pre-trained embeddings with their file paths and dimensions
preprocess_args: preprocess the args namespace to set up cache paths, checkpoint paths, and resolve embeddings
configure_optimizer_and_lr: configure the optimizer type, learning rate, and learning rate scheduling parameters
set_embedder_config: set embedder parameters including attention type, dropout, projection size, and embedding mix mode
